scope: Proposition 5.1 (Early pairing) of the manuscript “Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree” (preprints/Deterministic-nonbipartite-Ramanujan-graphs-in-every-fixed-degree-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 178 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d8ea4bb85aae750), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the fixed parameters of the construction and all sufficiently large n, the simultaneous discounted-account rule can be run from the empty pairing down to l1 unresolved stubs. It retains the structural estimates (4.3)–(4.8), positivity of every tracked precision, and, at every tracked point, |L1| ≤ n.075a /α∗, |L0| ≤ n.105a /α2 ∗, max i,j |Eij| ≤ n.33a / p l0. The low-square estimates (5.12) hold with any prescribed sufficiently small fixed loss exponent, for any fixed near radius needed in the proof. At every primary point, T ≥ n−θ/2 (n−1 + α/l)−1 (5.1) after a fixed constant is allowed in the right-hand side.
